hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'npm run dev|npm start'; then ENV_FILE=/home/user/finance-dashboard/server/.env; if [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ] && grep -qE '^ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=.+' "$ENV_FILE"; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is active in server/.env — starting the dev server enables live Claude API billing. Run the command manually in a terminal if you intended this."}'; exit 0; fi; fi; exit 0
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" == /home/user/finance-dashboard/client/* ]]; then cd /home/user/finance-dashboard/client && npx eslint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" != *.test.ts ]]; then exit 0; fi; if [[ "$f" == /home/user/finance-dashboard/server/* ]]; then rel="${f#/home/user/finance-dashboard/server/}"; cd /home/user/finance-dashboard/server && npx vitest run "$rel" 2>&1 | tail -20; fi; }

USAGE=$(curl -sf http://localhost:3001/api/usage 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$USAGE" ]; then COST=$(echo "$USAGE" | jq -r '.totals.estimated_cost_usd // "0.000000"' 2>/dev/null); CALLS=$(echo "$USAGE" | jq -r '.totals.calls // 0' 2>/dev/null); echo "--- Claude API session summary: ${CALLS} call(s), ~\$${COST} estimated cost ---"; fi
